note: One curated resource — appliance/banners — is live-change-and-rollback-verified against Orchestrator 9.7.0.43282 / ECOS 9.7.0.0_109184 (2026-08-30): a real change applied, verified on the appliance, confirmed, rolled back, and persisted to flash at both ends. Four more are live-no-op-write-verified and 33 are live-read-verified. Level 5 is the floor for calling a write path supported, so exactly one write path in this repository has met that floor; every other write is still code that has not been applied and rolled back on real gear. A programmatic equivalent of the level-4 check passed for 33 write-capable kinds with zero phantom drift, recorded as supporting evidence in docs/sitrep/2026-08-30-live-read.md rather than promoted, because the ledger records levels by the procedure actually run. Three kinds stay at mock-verified because nothing of that kind is configured on the observed fabric. docs/live-validation.md is the protocol, including the four failure paths level 6 needs and that none has exercised.

Template-owned, so the write needed --override-template: the `banners` template body IS the banner text, which is ownership being correct rather than over-scoped. The endpoint rejects non-ASCII (400 on an em-dash).
